results.name: St Magnus the Martyr London Bridge Model
results.description:
A scale model of one of the versions of London Bridge (from around 1400) on display in the church of St Magnus the Martyr on Lower Thames Street, London.

Date: 1987

This is a quick scan with the photos taken through the glass display cabinet. Hence the model is a little noisy, particularly at the ends.

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/St_Magnus-the-Martyr

Ian Visits blog post:
https://www.ianvisits.co.uk/blog/2012/09/30/a-scale-model-of-old-london-bridge/

320 photos taken (through glass) in July 2019 with a Sony a6000 and processed in Agisoft Metashape.

results.name: Animated display Cabinet
results.description:
This is completely free to use.

The superior door can open up to 100 degrees - any further and the hinges are exposed.

The inferior glass door opens up to 90 degrees. - if you want to use in unity keep in mind that some extra action data is included - just remove the 2 that dont match - delete the action named inferior that is associated with the superior door and same for other. 

Just reverse it in Unity to get the closing animation.

Textures – all in 1k (sourced from Poly Haven) come with metal and plywood textures: diffuse maps, and normal maps.

The glass requires a material when placed in.

results.name: Antique curiosity skull cabinet
results.description:
Antique curiosity cabinet displaying a preserved skull inside a wooden and glass case.
Inspired by an image I randomly stumbled upon on Pinterest.
The Latin inscription suggests a philosophical reflection on the boundary between human reason and animal instinct.

The model was created as a game-ready asset with detailed wood, glass, and bone materials.
